result.summary: The image shows a commercial urban intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure like traffic signals and lane markings are present, the wide crossing distance and lack of pedestrian refuge islands or visible pedestrian signals increase risk.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left side of the street may block the view between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides of a commercial street. While traffic signals are present, the lack of curb extensions and the presence of parked vehicles near the crossing create potential visibility hazards for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars on the right side of the street close to the intersection may block the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway near the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

result.summary: This signalized commercial intersection features sidewalks and pedestrian signals but suffers from significant maintenance issues and wide crossing distances. Faded pavement markings and sidewalk obstructions like trash bags reduce the overall safety and comfort for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are heavily worn and faded, making the crossing less visible to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Sidewalk obstructions
hazards.description: Large piles of trash bags are blocking a significant portion of the sidewalk on the left side of the image.
hazards.location_in_image: Left sidewalk in front of the commercial buildings

hazards.name: Wide crossing exposure
hazards.description: The lack of curb extensions or a median refuge increases the time pedestrians spend in the path of vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks using high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
